dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Justin Herbert Enters Concussion Protocol as Chargers Fall to 1-9
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Following a 27-24 loss to the New York Jets that dropped Los Angeles to 1-9 under head coach Jim Harbaugh, quarterback Justin Herbert entered concussion protocol. The Chargers now prepare for Week 12 while ranking last in offensive EPA (-10.04).
bullets: Quarterback Justin Herbert entered concussion protocol following Sunday's Week 11 home defeat, threatening his availability for Week 12 as reported by [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50567478/chargers-justin-herbert-lands-concussion-protocol).

Wide receiver Ladd McConkey secured two touchdown receptions from Herbert during the comeback attempt, highlighting an individual bright spot outlined by [chargers.com Official](https://www.chargers.com/news/jets-takeaways-justin-herbert-jim-harbaugh-week-11) and [chargers.com Video](https://www.chargers.com/video/ladd-mcconkey-highlight-6-yard-touchdown-vs-jets-week-11-2026).

Rookie running back Omarion Hampton broke free for a season-long 36-yard rush, offering rare explosive production for a unit averaging league-worst third-down conversions (32.3%) per [chargers.com Video](https://www.chargers.com/video/omarion-hampton-highlight-36-yard-run-vs-jets-week-11-2026).

Outside linebacker Tuli Tuipulotu emphasized regrouping after defense allowed scores on New York's opening five possessions, according to [chargers.com Video](https://www.chargers.com/video/tuli-tuipulotu-media-availability-jets-week-11-2026).
